privileged_mode_enabled.title: Privileged Mode Enabled
privileged_mode_enabled.description: Whether the container is running in privileged mode, which grants the full set of host Linux capabilities, bypasses LSM enforcement, and disables most kernel isolation primitives.

dangerous_capabilities_granted.title: Dangerous Capabilities Granted
dangerous_capabilities_granted.description: List of high-risk Linux capabilities explicitly added or present in the container's effective capability set (e.g., CAP_NET_ADMIN, CAP_SYS_PTRACE, CAP_SYS_MODULE, CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE).

all_capabilities_dropped.title: All Capabilities Dropped
all_capabilities_dropped.description: Whether the container configuration explicitly drops ALL capabilities (e.g., drop: [ALL] in Kubernetes securityContext or equivalent runtime config).

dropped_capabilities.title: Dropped Linux Capabilities
dropped_capabilities.description: List of Linux capabilities explicitly dropped from the container's capability set (e.g., CAP_NET_ADMIN, CAP_SYS_PTRACE, CAP_SYS_MODULE).

seccomp_profile_type.title: Seccomp Profile Type
seccomp_profile_type.description: The type of seccomp profile applied to the container or pod. 'Unconfined' means no syscall filtering. 'RuntimeDefault' uses the runtime's default profile. 'Localhost' uses a custom host profile. 'None' indicates the field is absent.

seccomp_profile_configured.title: Seccomp Profile Configured
seccomp_profile_configured.description: Whether a seccomp profile is explicitly configured on the pod or container security context. False or absent means no profile is set, defaulting to unconfined behavior in most runtimes.

lsm_profile_enforced.title: LSM Profile Enforced
lsm_profile_enforced.description: Whether an active AppArmor, SELinux, or equivalent LSM mandatory access control profile is applied and enforced on the container runtime (not merely loaded or in permissive/disabled mode).

lsm_profile_mode.title: LSM Profile Mode
lsm_profile_mode.description: The operational mode of the applied LSM profile: 'enforce' actively blocks violations, 'permissive' only logs them, 'disabled' means no profile is active.

shared_pid_namespace.title: Shared PID Namespace Enabled
shared_pid_namespace.description: Whether the container is configured to share the host or another container's PID namespace (hostPID: true or shareProcessNamespace: true in pod spec), breaking process-level isolation.

shared_ipc_namespace.title: Shared IPC Namespace Enabled
shared_ipc_namespace.description: Whether the container is configured to share the host or another container's IPC namespace (hostIPC: true), enabling shared memory segments, semaphores, and message queues across trust boundaries.

cross_zone_namespace_sharing_detected.title: Cross-Zone Namespace Sharing Detected
cross_zone_namespace_sharing_detected.description: Whether analysis has confirmed that the PID or IPC namespace is shared between containers belonging to different trust zones (e.g., a DMZ container and an internal-network container share a namespace).

egress_network_policy_enforced.title: Egress Network Policy Enforced
egress_network_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether a CNI-level NetworkPolicy or equivalent egress filtering rule is applied to the workload, restricting outbound connections to explicitly allowed destinations.

cloud_metadata_service_reachable.title: Cloud Metadata Service Reachable
cloud_metadata_service_reachable.description: Indicates whether the container can reach the cloud instance metadata service (e.g., 169.254.169.254) without egress filtering blocking that destination, enabling credential theft.

ingress_policy_scope.title: Ingress Policy Scope
ingress_policy_scope.description: The broadest scope permitted by ingress network policy rules for this workload or namespace — whether ingress is unrestricted, namespace-wide, cluster-wide, or explicitly zone-scoped.

cross_zone_ingress_enforced.title: Cross-Zone Ingress Enforcement Active
cross_zone_ingress_enforced.description: Whether network policies explicitly restrict ingress to only permitted trust zones using zone-identifying labels on namespaceSelector or podSelector.

default_deny_ingress_policy_present.title: Default Deny Ingress Policy Present
default_deny_ingress_policy_present.description: Whether a default-deny NetworkPolicy exists in the namespace that blocks all ingress traffic unless explicitly permitted by an allow rule.

secret_projection_cross_zone.title: Cross-Zone Secret Projection Detected
secret_projection_cross_zone.description: Indicates whether secrets (as environment variables) are projected into pods residing in a different trust zone than the zone that owns the secret, or whether init containers with embedded secrets are shared across trust zones.

sidecar_injection_scope.title: Sidecar Injection Trust Zone Scope
sidecar_injection_scope.description: Defines whether sidecar injection (e.g., service mesh, secrets agent) is scoped strictly to a single trust zone or spans multiple trust zones, potentially propagating env-var secrets across zone boundaries.

service_account_token_projected.title: Service Account Token Projected Into Container
service_account_token_projected.description: Indicates whether a service account token is mounted into the container, either via automountServiceAccountToken or an explicit projected volume.

token_audience_binding_configured.title: Token Audience Binding Configured
token_audience_binding_configured.description: Indicates whether the projected service account token has an explicit audience field restricting it to a specific service audience. Tokens without audience binding are valid against any API server audience.

token_long_lived.title: Service Account Token Long-Lived
token_long_lived.description: Whether the projected service account token has an expiration exceeding 86400 seconds (24 hours), indicating a long-lived token that increases the blast radius of compromise.

inter_zone_flow_logging_enabled.title: Inter-Zone Network Flow Logging Enabled
inter_zone_flow_logging_enabled.description: Indicates whether network flow logging (e.g., CNI-level flow logs, iptables logging, or cloud VPC flow logs) is configured and active on paths between trust zones within the cluster.

runtime_network_monitoring_solution.title: Runtime Network Monitoring Solution
runtime_network_monitoring_solution.description: The type of runtime network monitoring deployed to observe inter-zone traffic, such as an eBPF-based tool or service mesh telemetry collector.

network_policy_enforcement_enabled.title: Network Policy Enforcement Enabled
network_policy_enforcement_enabled.description: Indicates whether Kubernetes NetworkPolicy or equivalent CNI-enforced policies are active between trust zones or on the workload, providing baseline traffic restriction.

host_pid_or_ipc_namespace_shared.title: Host PID or IPC Namespace Shared
host_pid_or_ipc_namespace_shared.description: Indicates whether the container shares the host PID or IPC namespace, which compounds trust boundary collapse when combined with privileged mode.

host_network_enabled.title: Host Network Namespace Enabled
host_network_enabled.description: Indicates whether the container/pod is configured with hostNetwork: true, sharing the host's network namespace and bypassing network segmentation.

workload_trust_zone.title: Workload Trust Zone
workload_trust_zone.description: The trust zone or security tier classification of the workload, used to assess severity of misconfigurations and the blast radius of boundary violations.
